# Spar 0.7.3

**Spar 0.7.3 makes in-app updates work on macOS. Updates used to stop with
"The update could not be verified as an authentic Spar release", because
macOS's built-in updater only accepts apps signed with a paid Apple developer
certificate, which this open build doesn't have. Spar now installs its own
updates.**

## Updating on macOS

- **Install this version by hand once.** 0.7.2 and earlier still have the old
  updater, so they can't install 0.7.3 themselves. Download it below and
  replace Spar in your Applications folder. Every update after this one
  installs from inside Spar.
- **How Spar checks an update.** It downloads the build for your Mac's chip
  and checks it against the checksum published with the release. It then
  confirms the app inside really is Spar, at the version it offered, before
  installing anything.
- **Installs and reopens on its own.** After Spar quits, the new version takes
  the old one's place and opens. If anything goes wrong, the previous version
  is put back and opens instead, and Spar tells you the update didn't install.
- **No Gatekeeper prompt after an update.** Spar downloads the update itself,
  so macOS doesn't ask you to approve it again, and you never need to run
  `xattr` after an update.
- If Spar is installed somewhere your account can't write to, macOS asks for
  your password once.
- If you're running Spar straight from the disk image, Spar asks you to move it
  to Applications first, since there's nowhere to install the update.

## Update notices

- **Updates use Spar's normal toast** in the bottom-right corner, with a thin
  progress bar while the update downloads. Click it to read what's new.
- **Plain release-notes dialogs.** The "what's new" and "updated to" dialogs
  just show the version and its notes.

## Updating on Windows

- The update installer now runs silently and reopens Spar, without showing a
  setup wizard partway through.

## Downloads

| Your machine | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac, Apple silicon | `Spar-0.7.3-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac, Intel | `Spar-0.7.3.dmg` |
| Windows | `Spar-0.7.3-x64.exe` |
| Linux | `Spar-0.7.3-x86_64.AppImage` or `Spar-0.7.3-amd64.deb` |

## Known limits

- This open distribution is unsigned. macOS Gatekeeper or Windows SmartScreen
  may ask you to approve the first launch of a downloaded installer. Updates
  installed from inside Spar don't ask again.
- Linux AppImage installations can self-update when the runtime supports it;
  `.deb` installations stay managed by the system package manager.
